title: OpenAI Agents Python SDK 发布 v0.21.0
description: Key Changes This minor release does not introduce a known breaking SDK behavior change. The minor version bump is for the new provider-neutral testing APIs and the OpenAI Python v3 compatibility update. Highlights: Added agents.testing, agents.realtime.testing, and agents.voice.testing utilities for deterministic Agent, Sandbox, Realtime, and Voice workflow tests without provider requests.
